title: Who it takes to build in a city

captions.instagram:
It takes a village to build in a city: architects, engineers, consultants and municipal processes, all coordinated.

Idea, approval, design, build. The way I see it, coordination is what turns a concept into a building. Save the 5-point coordination check.

#RealEstate #Construction #UrbanDevelopment

Who would you coordinate first?
captions.facebook:
Architects shape it. Engineers make it stand. Consultants add expertise. The city approves it. I put who does what on an urban project in one carousel.

#Construction #RealEstate

Which role do you think is most underrated?
captions.linkedin:
Coordination turns a concept into a built project.

An urban project depends on four groups: architects (design), engineers (structure), consultants (specialist expertise) and municipal processes (approvals). When they work in silos, surprises show up at approval and work gets redone. When they share one plan, approvals are planned for.

The check I'd run: Who owns the plan? Who talks to the city? Who approves changes? How are teams updated? What is the review rhythm?

#Construction #ProjectManagement

Where does coordination break down most?
